known.title: Agents: Never take secrets by speech or chat
Keep the documented schema inventory entries as strings
Document settings for all three test API containers

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 4 (floor: agents)
Raise: Security. Case: normal use - someone pastes `OTP 123456` or `password hunter2` into chat. The matcher requires `:`, `=` or `is` after the label, so both labelled secrets return false. These are outside the accepted limitation for unlabelled passwords. The README at lines 164–168 instructs callers to save/send messages when this check returns false, allowing these secrets into checkpoints and provider requests. Recognize whitespace-separated labelled values and cover them in the guard cases.
Adds work: extend the existing label matcher; F 2 x H 3 = 6; 2 x C = 2
findings.title: Agents: Never take secrets by speech or chat

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - an agent follows the README to copy the module. The replacement snippet contains adjacent singleton tuples without separating commas. Inserting it into `EXPECTED_TABLE_SCHEMAS` breaks Python parsing; adding commas still leaves nested tuples where strings are required by `starter-python/apps/api/tests/test_module_schemas.py:60`. Restore comma-terminated string entries. The copy helper already inserts the correct strings, so its passing tests would miss this broken installation instruction.
findings.title: Keep the documented schema inventory entries as strings

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - a copied app runs its documented `node scripts/test.mjs` check. Host settings or `.env` entries do not automatically enter Compose containers. The starter's `compose.test.yml:17`, `:33` and `:50` explicitly list each API's environment and omit the assistant variables. The new `cleanup.py:78` therefore stops startup with a missing-key error. The test helper supplies the missing configuration at `tests/assistant_copy_python.py:59–75`, but the README never tells adopters to apply that necessary step. Include equivalent dummy settings for all three test services in the copy instructions.
findings.title: Document settings for all three test API containers
